def solve():
    collateral = Q(15000)
    debt = Q(7000)
    shock = Q(15) / 100
    lt = Q(80) / 100
    close = Q(45) / 100
    fee = Q(10) / 100
    target = Q(70) / 100

    post = collateral * (1 + shock)
    liquidatable = debt > lt * post

    if liquidatable:
        repaid = debt * close
        seized = repaid * (1 + fee)
    else:
        repaid = Q(0)
        seized = Q(0)

    remaining_collateral = post - seized
    remaining_debt = debt - repaid

    needed = remaining_debt / target
    deposit = max(needed - remaining_collateral, Q(0))

    return {
        "final": deposit,
        "post_shock_collateral_value": post,
        "repaid_debt": repaid,
        "seized_collateral_value": seized,
        "remaining_collateral_value": remaining_collateral,
    }
